title: Ines and the Debt
author: Sebastian Vane
blurb: Xanthe Yarrow, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
